root.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Modern Variation
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 e6 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. Bg5

overview: White pins the f6 knight. Black normally plays ...Be7, then castles and meets Nf3 with the Orthodox, Tartakower (...h6, ...b6) or Lasker (...Ne4) set-ups. Black's centre is bulletproof and the play is slow, with Black freeing his game via ...c5 or ...Ne4 trades. 4...Nbd7 and 4...Bb4 lead to Cambridge Springs-type play.

white_ideas.idea: Pressure d5, Rc1 and cxd5 exchange with a minority attack
e3, Nf3, Bd3 and queenside play before any e4 break

black_ideas.idea: Free the c8 bishop by ...b6 or ...dxc4, or trade pieces with ...Ne4

typical_structures.structure: Orthodox QGD with pawns d5/e6 against c4/d4/e3, tension in the centre

character.notes: Orthodox QGD is a Solid anchor; slow, technical play.

character.reason: Orthodox QGD is hard to break down and play is steady.

structure.reason: Centre tension persists, as with the QGD anchor.

plans.reason: The plans differ with sub-line choice.
